presets.name: coding-llms
presets.label: Coding-LLM survey (demo)
presets.prompt: Research the current state of open-weight large language models for coding. Compare the top 3 models on context window, license, and reported benchmark performance, then write a short summary with a recommendation. Record your findings to the shared workspace.

presets.name: engine-dossier
presets.label: Inference-engine dossier (complex swarm)
presets.prompt:
Produce a rigorous, cited comparison dossier on three open-source LLM inference engines -- vLLM, SGLang, and llama.cpp -- plus a small working demo, by coordinating a TEAM of subagents through the shared workspace. Do not do all the work yourself: decompose and delegate.

Wave 1 (parallel research -- spawn one subagent per engine): each subagent uses the browser to visit that engine's official GitHub repository and documentation and extracts four facts -- supported quantization formats, continuous/batched inference support, multi-GPU / tensor-parallel support, and one notable recent feature (with its source URL). Each subagent writes findings/<engine>.md (engine = vllm, sglang, or llamacpp) into the shared workspace, containing those four facts with citations.

Wave 2 (synthesis + demo -- only after Wave 1 finishes): spawn one subagent that reads all three findings files, then writes tools/compare.py -- a Python script that builds a comparison table from the facts and prints it (install any needed package such as tabulate with pip, and actually RUN the script, redirecting its output to tools/compare.txt) -- and finally writes DOSSIER.md with the sections ## Summary, ## vLLM, ## SGLang, ## llama.cpp, ## Comparison table, and ## Recommendation, embedding the produced table and citing the source URLs.

Finish: verify in the shared workspace that findings/vllm.md, findings/sglang.md and findings/llamacpp.md all exist, that tools/compare.txt was produced by running the script, and that DOSSIER.md contains all six sections. Only then stop. If any check fails, spawn a fix-up subagent and re-verify before stopping.
